column1: # Failures main is known to have, excluded by tools/gate and printed in every gate that meets them.
# One row each, tab-separated: id, reason, owner lane (the step fixing it), date (UTC).
# id: a test target (hirsel-rt-test-it-shard-2), a binary and case (hirsel-rt-test-it::replay::kill_order)
# or a corpus case (conformance/MEM/MEM-7-x-run.hir). Rows are added to main directly, never through
# tools/land (it refuses a change that adds one); tools/land removes a lane's rows when that lane lands.
